text:
Anya: Quick sync — proposing a lightweight model admission gating flow + customer pin exception path. TL;DR: checklist-based onboarding, numeric quality/perf thresholds, and a 90-day pin exemption for strategic customers. Need alignment on MVP vs v2. @miguel @sam

Miguel: skimming. what are the exact perf/pass metrics? p95, token cost? QE + infra need quantitative pass/fail so they can sign off.

Priya: +1 for quantitative. Proposed minimal eval set: 1) generation perplexity delta <= 12% vs baseline, 2) hallucination rate (QA eval) <= 6%, 3) embedding cosine recall@10 >= 0.88. All run on our standard eval harness.

Sam: perf cutoffs: p95 <= 220ms for short seq (<=128 tokens), avg per-token cost delta <= 1.25x vs baseline. If a model fails perf but passes quality, we can offer a reduced-throughput tier or dedicated slow path — but that's v2 unless we accept higher hosted cost.

Riley: we need rollout controls in the onboarding flow: canaries, region pinning, and automated fallback to a compatible variant if capacity constrained. Also: audit trail on pin exemptions (who granted, reason, expiry).

Jason: customer note: 90-day pin exemption is OK but they'll ask for auto-renew. recommend product approval required on every renewal. also need a visible flag in Console for CSMs to see pins + expiry.

Anya: Proposed MVP launch criteria: checklist + automated eval harness run on PR; quality thresholds (Priya's numbers); perf thresholds (Sam's numbers); canary at 1% traffic for 24h with rollback hooks; pin exemption API + Console UI to request/approve (90-day TTL).

Anya: v2 scope (post-launch): automated compatibility shim (auto-fallthrough to next-best variant), auto-renew flow for enterprise pins (with audit), and per-model batching/quantization guidance surfaced in Console.

Miguel: for the pin API, propose a minimal JSON contract so infra and Console can integrate quickly:

```
POST /catalog/pins
{
  "customer_id": "acct-123",
  "model_id": "redwood-llama-13b-v2",
  "expires_at": "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z",
  "reason": "regulatory-testing",
  "requester": "account-team"
}
```

Response should include approver, approver_note, and audit_id.

Riley: add: pin records must be visible to and enforced by the routing layer so pin precedence is applied before smart-routing. otherwise pins can break SLAs.

Priya: small ask: include a mandatory eval prompt-set that represents customer-sensitive domains (finance/legal) where hallucination metrics are weighted more heavily.

Sam: implementation note — per-customer pinned variants add complexity to KV cache isolation and routing. estimate ~2x dev effort and perf risk. MVP recommendation: support pins for top-10 enterprise accounts only; broader rollout in v2.

Anya: proposed decisions for this thread:
- Approve MVP launch criteria (checklist + thresholds + pin API + Console request/approve + 90-day TTL)
- Accept limited pin scope (top-10 accounts) for MVP
- Defer automated compatibility shim & auto-renew to v2

Miguel: approve MVP decision, but we need clear engineering tickets and a sprint estimate. I can own runtime ticketing + perf validation.

Riley: approve; I'll scope routing + audit logging work with Sam.

Priya: approve thresholds; will hand off eval harness + prompt-sets by EOW.

Jason: approve; I'll draft CSM guidance for pin requests and renewals.

Anya: thanks everyone — next steps: I'll create a short PRD with the checklist and the minimal pin API contract, and schedule a 30m kickoff with eng+ops+research tomorrow. Owners: Miguel (runtime), Riley (routing/audit), Priya (evals), Jason (CSM docs). Any objections?

ops-bot: kickoff meeting created — 1715558000

Miguel: no objections. +1

Riley: +1

Priya: +1

Jason: +1 :thumbsup:

Anya: filing PRD now and will ping once draft is up for review.
